segments.text: Got a bit of an idea that's interesting for a video, which is to sell the Ivy product itself. It's to get several creators and have them talking to the device, with the hook being that the ideas are connected into something like Mr. Beast's.
Mr. Beast's viral video that I was watching the other day on YouTube, if you can find it.

The video should be pretty short. I'm thinking that we have it in different hands and different people, and that the goal of the video is to make the product, then the AI, and then the output, and then a video all really seamless, all really fun.

And I think fun is the goal, is to make the UI and the AI really personable and really, I guess, optimistic around great ideas and talkative, and we can kind of show the visuals of that rather than lots of fun.
Like to have your thoughts on it and put together some ideas and storyboards and even some demo concepts.

cards.title: Several creators talking to the device
cards.gist: A launch video where multiple creators each speak to the Ivy device and their ideas get connected together.

cards.title: Short video, many hands, seamless flow
cards.gist: Keep it short and pass the device between different hands and people so product, AI, output and video feel like one seamless, fun chain.

cards.title: Make the AI personable and optimistic
cards.gist: The UI and AI should read as fun, talkative and optimistic about ideas, shown visually rather than stated.

loose_ends.text: Find the Mr. Beast viral video she watched on YouTube the other day.

requests.text: Give thoughts on the concept and put together ideas, storyboards and demo concepts.
